title: Why anodized parts fail early (whiteboard demo)
audience: Design engineers and buyers specifying anodized aluminum parts (website, LinkedIn, sales follow-up email)

scenes.text: Why do some anodized parts fade or corrode within a year, while others last for decades?
A durable finish takes four steps. We clean the raw part, the tank grows a hard oxide layer, we dye it, and then we seal it.
Skip or rush the seal, and the pores stay open. The color fades, and corrosion gets in.
Send us your drawing. We confirm the coating class and seal test before production starts.
